config.network.interface.description: Network interface name (or local IPv4 address) used for the CLU discovery broadcast. Empty = first non-internal IPv4. Use the "OpenGr8on: Select Network Interface" command to pick one.
config.uploadOnSave.description: Generate and upload OM.LUA / USER.LUA when a project file is saved.
config.devices.checkAliveIntervalSec.des: Background check alive of every CLU in the Devices view (seconds; 0 = off). Keeps online / last seen current; a CLU that answered anything else within the interval is not asked. Module values are read only for expanded modules.
config.liveValues.intervalMs.description: Polling interval for live values of expanded modules in the Devices view (ms). Each tick sends one batched req: per CLU.
config.liveValues.push.description: Let CLUs push changed values (SYSTEM:clientRegister to a UDP port of this computer) instead of polling them; a CLU whose pushes do not arrive (e.g. blocked by a firewall) is polled.
config.generate.lineEndings.description: Line endings of generated OM.LUA / USER.LUA (Object Manager writes its platform's). Use the one of the Object Manager you compare with.
